# Column-Krater (Mixing Bowl)

GameCore theme sourced from a **real design object** in the Art Institute of Chicago.

## Work
- **Title:** Column-Krater (Mixing Bowl)
- **Artist / Maker:** Attributed to a Member of the Earlier Mannerist Group Greek; Athens
- **Date:** about 460 BCE
- **Style / Period:** attic
- **Classification:** vessel
- **Department:** Arts of Greece, Rome, and Byzantium
- **AIC artwork ID:** 164
